subject: Graduate / Junior Estimator application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi WIP Construction team,

I'm applying for the Graduate / Junior Estimator role in Cairns, advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reviewing drawings, tracking procurement and materials and writing progress reports. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I'm open to discussing a move to Cairns.

Your advert says you will teach estimating to someone who wants to learn how projects are priced and delivered, and that is what I'm after. My estimating so far is coursework, not a paid estimating role.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.company_line: WIP Construction built the $5.4 million Followmont Transport Depot in Woree, where poor ground conditions needed iterative soil testing and careful pour timing, and the slabs were finished with no re-pours.
letter.subject: Application for Graduate / Junior Estimator, Cairns
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate / Junior Estimator role with your Cairns team, advertised on SEEK. Your advert says you would rather teach estimating to someone with the right attitude than hire for experience, and that is the start I am looking for.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. That course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and I prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as a project-in-charge engineer on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports and material records, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I read about your Followmont Transport Depot in Woree, where soil testing and careful pour timing kept the slabs right first time. Seeing how an estimate turns into work like that is why this role appeals to me. My estimating experience is coursework rather than a paid role, and I have not used estimating software such as Bluebeam yet. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and am open to discussing relocation to Cairns.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
